_description: OCI MI300X cluster (SLURM cluster m2m, login nodes useocpslog-00x). Allocation defaults for the multinode launchers. Both CI paths read this file: MADENGINE passes it to madengine as the base of --additional-context, STANDALONE turns the same resolved values into sbatch options. Anything in ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT overrides it. Facts the job itself needs once it is running (filesystems, fabric, ports) stay in ../cluster.sh.
